part.text: All tests pass. The fix is a one-line change in `include/fmt/format.h:1856` (hex float padding path in `detail::write`): instead of always using `left_padding_shifts` — which made unspecified alignment (`align::none`, shift 31) produce zero left padding and thus left alignment — it now selects the shifts table the same way `write_padded` does (`align::left ? left_padding_shifts : right_padding_shifts`). `right_padding_shifts[align::none] == 0` gives full left padding, so `{:16a}` is right-aligned by default, while explicit `<`, `>`, `^`, fill, and sign handling are unaffected, and the whole test suite still passes.
